changelog:
• Guaranteed User-Applied Chart Workspace Persistence (v3.5.1 Hotfix): Full-fidelity indicator parameters, styles, and drawings saved and restored across restarts
• Explicit User Intent Tracking: Distinguishes intentional user deletions (USER_ACTION) from startup race-condition empty wipes (APPLICATION_INIT / PAGE_RELOAD)
• Schema v2 State Machine: Deterministic SHA-256 state hashing with PENDING -> CAPTURING -> VALID -> SAVING -> SAVED lifecycle
• Verified TradingView Restoration Loop: Query -> Diff -> Bounded Repair -> Verification loop with bounded retries and zero infinite loops
• Strict Multi-Symbol Isolation: Eliminates indicator bleed and drawing carryover when switching between BTCUSD, ETHUSD, and SOLUSD
• Subtle Workspace Status Badge: Visual feedback on chart canvas ('✓ Workspace saved', '● Saving workspace...', '⚡ Recovered from backup')
• Developer ChartStateDebugger: Comprehensive 7-stage transition snapshot diffing and component hash verification
